# SQLite

Small. Fast. Reliable. Choose any three.

SQLite is a C-language library that implements a small, fast, self-contained,
high-reliability, full-featured, SQL database engine.

- Homepage: https://www.sqlite.org
- Documentation: https://www.sqlite.org/docs.html
- License: public domain (see `LICENSE`)

This directory vendors the official "amalgamation" build — the entire SQLite
core compiled as two files, `sqlite3.c` and `sqlite3.h` — as produced and
distributed by the SQLite developers themselves. See `VENDORED_COMMIT.txt` for
the exact version and integrity verification.
